description: This file defines the 'Authorization' class, which models the '<authorization>' element within the service configuration. It primarily handles extracting and validating the 'service-name' attribute from an XML element.

classes.name: Authorization
classes.description: Immutable class representing a service authorization configuration, encapsulating the service name required for authorization checks.

methods.name: Authorization
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Authorization object by extracting the 'service-name' attribute from the provided XML element. Throws ServiceConfigException if the attribute is missing or empty.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Accessor method that returns the service name associated with this authorization.
